title: HELENA for 5G NR LEO NTN Channel Estimation: A Comparative Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14735v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Learning (DL)-based channel estimation has shown high accuracy and low latency in terrestrial 5G NR, but Low Earth Orbit (LEO) Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTNs) introduce Doppler and synchronization impairments that may require NTN-specific architectures. We test whether High-Efficiency Learning-based channel Estimation using dual Neural Attention (HELENA), originally designed for terrestrial channels, remains effective after NTN retraining and suitable across high-performance and power-constrained inference platforms. Its unchanged architecture is trained on paired receiver-compensated (NTN-1) and residual-impaired (NTN-2) datasets and compared with eight terrestrial-origin models trained on the same NTN data and the NTN-specific MDELAN-SISO. HELENA achieves the lowest observed SNR-averaged NMSE among the DL estimators in both conditions, including 55.8-62.7% lower linear-scale NMSE than MDELAN-SISO. All DL models degrade in NTN-2,

translated_title: 用于5G NR低轨卫星非地面网络信道估计的HELENA：一项对比评估
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习（DL）的信道估计在地面5G NR中已展现出高精度和低延迟，但低地球轨道（LEO）非地面网络（NTN）引入的多普勒和同步损伤可能需要NTN专用的架构。我们测试了最初为地面信道设计的双神经注意力高效学习信道估计方法（HELENA）在经过NTN重训练后是否仍然有效，以及是否适用于高性能和功耗受限的推理平台。其未作改动的架构在成对的接收端补偿（NTN-1）和残余损伤（NTN-2）数据集上进行训练，并与在相同NTN数据上训练的八个地面来源模型以及NTN专用的MDELAN-SISO进行比较。HELENA在两种条件下都实现了DL估计器中观测到的最低SNR平均NMSE，包括比MDELAN-SISO低55.8-62.7%的线性尺度NMSE。所有DL模型在NTN-2条件下均出现性能退化。
tldr: HELENA经NTN重训练后在低轨卫星非地面网络信道估计任务中表现最优，其线性尺度NMSE比NTN专用模型MDELAN-SISO低55.8-62.7%，且在高性能和功耗受限平台上均表现良好。
en_tdlr: HELENA remains the most effective DL channel estimator for LEO NTN after retraining, achieving 55.8-62.7% lower linear-scale NMSE than the NTN-specific MDELAN-SISO while remaining suitable for both high-performance and power-constrained inference platforms.
